description: This file defines the ReminderManager class responsible for scheduling, canceling, rescheduling reminders, and sending notifications within an Android app. It interacts with repositories for reminders and notes, manages alarms, and creates notifications.

classes.name: ReminderManager
classes.description: Manages scheduling, canceling, rescheduling reminders, and sending notifications for notes within the app.

methods.name: requestBroadcast
methods.description: Creates a PendingIntent for a reminder broadcast with specified reminder and note IDs.

methods.name: isReminderSet
methods.description: Checks if a reminder is already scheduled for given reminder and note IDs.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules an alarm for a reminder at a specified date/time.

methods.name: cancelAllRemindersForNote
methods.description: Cancels all reminders associated with a specific note.

methods.name: rescheduleAll
methods.description: Reschedules all reminders, deleting expired ones.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification when a reminder fires, with details from the reminder or note repositories.
